nom: Live Tinted Hueguard Invisible Sunscreen Stick SPF 50

segments.oily: Reviewers who describe themselves as oily report the formula mattifies lightly without feeling greasy or stripped, leaving skin refreshed and balanced through the day; one long-time oily-skin user, however, found daily use eventually left her skin dry and irritated, especially combined with topical acne medication.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dry-combination skin are split: some say it adds a light layer of moisture even under makeup, while at least one with dry/combination skin found it pulled moisture out and left her feeling dried through, even applied over a moisturizer.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report no white cast, a soft blur to the skin, and better oil control than other mineral sunscreens they had tried, though one combination-skin reviewer found the same formula drying.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some prone to rosacea, describe it as calming and non-irritating with no pilling and no white cast; one reviewer who does not normally have sensitive skin still experienced eye burning, peeling and a white cast, and another reviewer cautions against daily use for sensitive skin because of its mattifying, drying effect.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who specifies normal-to-slightly-dry skin recommends the product for that skin type, though her review centers on receiving an expired unit rather than on the formula's performance.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, across skin types, describe the formula as lightweight and hydrating rather than stripping; several with dry or combination skin disagree, reporting it dried their skin out — in one case even when layered over a moisturizer — and one oily-skin reviewer found daily use caused dry patches from the mattifying effect.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with dry/combination skin described the formula as pulling moisture through her skin barrier, leaving her drier even over a moisturizing serum and cream; this is the only report framed in barrier terms, and most other reviewers describe the formula as hydrating rather than stripping.
concerns.redness: Reviewers prone to rosacea repeatedly report no flare-ups and describe the formula as calming on reactive skin, with no stinging or rashes; one reviewer who does not normally react to products experienced burning eyes and peeling after use.
concerns.spots: Reviewers who describe hyperpigmentation-prone skin say the tinted, iron-oxide formula blends without a cast and helps visually even out discoloration while it fades, with no reports of it worsening dark spots.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who call themselves acne-prone, report no new breakouts and no clogged pores; two reviewers, however, developed breakouts — one general acne and one cystic acne — after starting the product.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin describe the formula as lightweight and lightly mattifying without feeling greasy, stripped, or heavy, and say it controls shine better than other mineral sunscreens they compared it to.

extraits.titre: Almost Perfect! Not for Dry Skin
extraits.texte: This sunscreen is super lightweight, non-greasy, plays well under makeup, and has solid full spectrum protection….however it is not moisturizing for my dry/combo skin. In fact it drys me out even after applying it over a moisturizing serum and cream - it's like it sucks through the barrier and my skin is left feeling

extraits.titre: Not a Daily Sunscreen for Sensitive Skin
extraits.texte: I like this sunscreen but only if I plan to wear makeup during the day. I dont usually wear makeup daily, but when I'm on trips or going out during the day and want to look nice Ill wear a little bit of makeup (concealer, powder, bronzer, blush). This stuff works GREAT as a sunscreen + primer as my makeup sticks to it so well. It also does not leave any white cast, but make sure to rub in well as it dries fast on the skin and can sometimes leave streaks. I dont like to use it daily as it does not combine well with my topical acne medications (makes my face feel VERY sticky - which is nice when using makeup, but not nice without makeup). Also, I feel as thought it is pretty drying on my skin due to the mattifying effect and I'm a very oily gal. Using daily tends to slighty irritate my skin and cause dry patches. That being said, if youre a sweaty and oily faced person like me, this stuff is a holy grail to use under makeup - but if you also have sensitive skin, I dont recommend using daily.

been using this spf for years now & i always come back to it as a brown girl with hyperpigmented prone skin. it has iron oxides, leaves no white cast despite being a mineral spf, & wears great under makeup! doesn't make my eyes burn either

I got a deluxe sample of this and it is the first western sunscreen that hasnt made my eyes sting. I am about a NC45 and there is no white cast for me - I recommend making sure any skincare underneath has dried/settled or it takes longer to rub in and "set". I have combination skin and for the most part it hasnt been greasy. It blurs my skin and makes it look nicer. I will definitely be full sizing, I am hyperpigmentation-prone so tinted sunscreen helps cover it better while it fades. It is a little runny in the 0.5 oz so the size between that and the 5.0 oz might be easier to manage the amount dispensed.

extraits.titre: My fav primer AND my fav sunscreen
extraits.texte: I love this stuff, I have sensitive skin that's prone to rosacea flares and this is such a great daily step in my skincare whether I want to put makeup on or not. It never pills under my foundation or nars tinted moisturizer and it also never makes me look like a ghost. The best!

This stuff is gorgeous! I was initially a little intimidated by its orange color, but rest assured it sheers out completely and leaves no color on my super fair skin. The formula is so silky and hydrating. . it feels like a nice, lightweight moisturizer. Since I am on the drier side I apply this over my moisturizer and under my makeup as a primer and it wears beautifully! I also wear this on no makeup days and it works great that way too. I am very acne prone and this formula has caused no irritation and no new breakouts for me. This is a great choice for a daily spf and I could see this working for just about anyone!

I have been using this since it came out a few years ago. It's the best thing I can put under make up. My skin is naturally a little oily but I like dewy make up looks at the same time, and I think this product matte-fies my face a little bit, helps my make up look more blended and stay on longer, while not being so matte that I don't look nicely moisturized. I LOVE it!
